page_title: Get customer SSO live in 7 days without burning engineer time
meta_description: Done-for-you SSO launch coordination for B2B SaaS teams that need enterprise customer SSO turned on fast.
for_whom: For 5-100 person B2B SaaS teams selling to enterprise customers with SSO requirements
hero_headline: Turn customer SSO live in 7 days — without dragging your senior engineers into endless IT threads
hero_subheadline: SSO Launch Desk runs the checklist, metadata exchange, role mapping, testing, and customer follow-through so your enterprise account goes live faster.
credibility_line: Least-privilege access. You keep control of auth settings. We coordinate the workflow and documentation.
pain_paragraph: You already support SSO in product, but each enterprise customer setup still turns into a slow project: metadata in one thread, role questions in another, test users blocked, and a senior engineer wasting hours playing coordinator. The deal is sold, but go-live drags because nobody owns the messy middle.
before: A signed enterprise deal still waits 1-2 weeks on SSO setup
Customer IT asks scattered questions across email and Slack
Senior engineers babysit SAML metadata, redirects, and role mappings
Nobody has a clear checklist, owner, or test plan
after: One owner for the SSO setup workflow
A clean IdP intake, metadata exchange, and role-mapping doc
A shared test plan with blockers surfaced fast
A go-live packet the customer and your team can both trust
offer_summary: SSO Go-Live Desk is a done-for-you launch workflow for one customer deployment. We collect the right inputs, keep the customer IT admin moving, document mapping decisions, run the test checklist, and hand off a clean go-live packet.
included: Customer IdP intake checklist (Okta, Entra ID/Azure AD, Google Workspace, OneLogin, generic SAML/OIDC)
Metadata exchange tracker and configuration handoff notes
Role / group mapping worksheet with named owners
Shared test plan for login, fallback, and JIT / provisioning behaviors
Final go-live packet with settings, decisions, and open follow-ups
excluded: Custom auth engineering or writing new SSO features
Security policy drafting or questionnaire work
process: 15-minute fit call to confirm your product already supports the target SSO flow
Kickoff + intake: collect customer IdP details, owners, environment info, and deadlines
Run metadata exchange, role mapping, and test-plan coordination with clear next steps
Surface blockers fast, keep both sides moving, and package the final go-live handoff
pricing_details: Starter covers one customer SSO deployment with one IdP, one test cycle, and up to 2 weeks of coordination. SCIM, advanced role mapping, and multi-environment setups are scoped separately. Optional ongoing identity support retainer starts at $500/mo.
guarantee_line: If we discover in week 1 that the issue is really missing product capability—not setup coordination—we stop and credit unused work toward a technical implementation partner.

faq.q: How do you handle security and access?
faq.a: Least-privilege only. We can work from screenshots, exported metadata, shared docs, and temporary admin access when necessary. No production credentials are stored outside approved systems.

faq.q: What prerequisites need to be true?
faq.a: Your product must already support the target SSO flow in a basically working state. You also need one internal technical owner and one customer-side admin who can answer IdP questions.
Usually less than 1 business day. We start with a short kickoff, an intake form, and a shared checklist so the first customer-facing message goes out quickly.

faq.q: Do you support SCIM or provisioning?
faq.a: Yes, when the product already supports it. We can coordinate mapping, test cases, and handoff, but we do not build missing provisioning features.
By default, we keep only the artifacts needed for the active setup and delete working copies after handoff unless you ask us to retain a reusable playbook longer.

trust_basics_line: You remain the source of truth for auth behavior and final configuration. We run the coordination, documentation, and go-live workflow.
